bagPolicy.summary: Nonclear bags up to 6 × 9 inches are allowed. Larger bags must be clear and no bigger than 12 × 12 × 6 inches; mesh does not count as clear, and medical or diaper bags are searched.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Concert parking usually opens two to three hours before showtime; arrival and pass instructions depend on the ticket and lot. Parking spaces are first come first served within each lot.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Set your rideshare pickup and drop-off address to 11450 Maxwell Road, Alpharetta, GA 30009.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold onsite; most outside food is prohibited. Each guest may bring one empty refillable bottle or a sealed water bottle up to one gallon, and guests with medical or dietary needs may bring food in a clear one-gallon bag.
allowed: One empty refillable bottle or sealed bottle up to one gallon
Dietary food in a clear one-gallon bag
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Guest Services is at the East and West gates and can provide wheelchair rides to seats. Medical device bags are permitted after inspection.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry after leaving; returning requires a new ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Pick up will call tickets at the box office at 2200 Encore Parkway with your ID; temporary parking is right in front for quick pickup. The box office is open Fridays 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., and opens at 10 a.m. on Monday to Saturday show days and noon on Sunday show days. You can't leave tickets at will call for others.

gates.summary: Guest Services booths operate at the East and West gates. Concert-specific gate opening times are published close to the event on its Know Before You Go page.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
